name: Lionheart's Legacy

start.dialog: ...Need parts for my gunblade. Lionheart isn't performing at peak. Crystal capacitors from the Prism formations should work. Get me five? I'll pay.
start.objective: Collect 5 crystal capacitors from Prism formations

progress.dialog: ...How many capacitors? Need five for the calibration. Don't want to overload the chamber.

complete.dialog: ...Perfect. These will do. Gunblade will hit harder now. Thanks. Here - GF compatibility module. Lets you junction better. Don't ask how it works. Magic.

party_comments.kade: Gunblade. Sword and gun combined. Interesting weapon.
party_comments.nix7: Weapon design: impractical. Combat effectiveness: undeniable.
party_comments.korr: Professional. Focused. I can work with this.

hidden_outcome: If you bring 10 capacitors, Squall trusts you enough to show 'Lionheart' his ultimate gunblade and gives you 'Pulse Ammo'
